metadata.selection: First UTC hour on 10 and 11 November 2026, selected post hoc before collection; two narrow matched cohorts, not full days or an adoption trend.
metadata.cohortMembership: Parent inclusion timestamp from the matching archived index; lower inclusive and upper exclusive.
metadata.sourceArchiveSeal: Set by the rebuild from the validated compressed archive bytes.

canonicalization: SHA-256(account + newline + recursively key-sorted JSON of decoded exact sign args); array order and JSON value types preserved; no field, address, payload or method alias normalization.

countUnits.inputs: Distinct account plus exact canonical signing-arguments groups within each selected cohort
countUnits.repeatExcess: Receipt-to-input assignments minus distinct inputs. Multiple distinct sign inputs in one receipt remain one request receipt.
